Our founder · The vision behind KCR
✧

Meet
Ritesh Joshi.

At the heart of KCR Events is Ritesh Joshi, bringing a Jodhpur-rooted perspective to the art of event planning and celebration design.

The philosophy is simple: honour the occasion, understand the people and give every detail a purpose. From royal wedding concepts to contemporary gatherings, KCR Events aims to create experiences that feel personal, elegant and memorable.
